review.scope: All compiler profiles apply the portable source change; byte-identical compiler lowering is explicitly retained as an identity control. Active profiles run all real PE and mixed-architecture panels, with no outlier removal.
review.checksum_scope: Native timing checks selected consumed values, instruction boundaries and rejection counts. It is not a byte-for-byte record comparison. Complete cs_insn/cs_detail records, unused bytes, cursors and errors are checked separately by the dedicated differential probes recorded for this source tree.
